title: Self-Defining USF and External Lineage Retirement
context: The USF constitutional layer previously grounded the foundation in a sibling repository as historical semantic/source evidence and lineage, and the Authority Model carried a seven-rank order whose rank 6 was a historical external source and semantic evidence class. The mechanism layer expressed this lineage through a source-import manifest attributed to an external repository at a frozen commit and tag, a source-reference allowlist of external-repository paths, per-instance source-evidence entries pointing at external compose and audit artefacts, and normalised proof-evidence records attributed to an external repository. The accountable owner has ratified, through the deliberate constitutional-amendment process, that USF must be self-defined with no external legacies: the external sibling-repository lineage authority is removed from the constitutional and mechanism layers and the external lineage record is deliberately discarded. React remains permitted as a UI framework technology choice; this decision retires only the external sibling-repository lineage authority, and it deliberately leaves the parity/equivalence documentation corpus, the react-app compose service, ADR 0005, and the non-UI parity validator to later phases.
decision: USF is re-founded as a self-originating, self-defined foundation. It derives all of its authority from its own artefacts and claims no external repository as its lineage or authority. The Authority Model's historical external-source-and-semantic-evidence authority class (formerly rank 6) is removed, and the operational authority order is re-numbered to six ranks ending in generated reports as the lowest rank: USF semantic definitions, USF ADRs, USF validator rules, runtime proof evidence, USF source implementation, generated reports. The source-import manifest is retained as USF's own self-defined source-path registry but re-founded: its top-level source repository is usf, and the per-entry external repository and tag attribution fields are discarded while every source path and target concept is preserved. The source-reference allowlist, the per-instance compose source-evidence, the enterprise-evidence source references, and the normalised observability proof-evidence attribution are re-attributed to the self-defined usf model, preserving each proof at its existing level and provider class with no downgrade and no schema violation. A governed semantic or ADR reference MUST be a canonical repository-local USF reference; a cross-repository discriminator in a governed reference is forbidden and MUST fail validation.
consequences: The Charter and Authority Model are amended: USF is self-originating and the authority order is six ranks ending in generated reports.
The agent directives no longer reference an external sibling repository and express the self-defined model.
The mechanism layer is re-attributed to the self-defined usf model and the external lineage record is discarded.

The parity/equivalence documentation corpus, the react-app compose service, ADR 0005, and the non-UI parity validator retain external references pending a later phase; a repository-wide zero-external-reference guard is deferred until that phase.
invariants: USF is self-defined and claims no external repository as its lineage or authority.
The operational authority order has six ranks; generated reports are the lowest rank.
There is no historical external-source-and-semantic-evidence authority class.
The source-import manifest is USF's own source-path registry; its top-level source repository is usf and its entries carry no external repository or tag attribution.
A governed semantic or ADR reference is a canonical repository-local USF reference; a cross-repository discriminator in a governed reference fails validation.
Re-founding preserves every source path and proof; no proof level or provider class is upgraded or downgraded.
permittedChanges: Author a repository-wide guard forbidding external cross-repository discriminators once the deferred corpus has been re-founded in a later phase.
Re-found or retire the parity/equivalence documentation corpus, the react-app compose service, ADR 0005, and the non-UI parity validator under a later authorised phase.
Add source-import rows that cover the currently allowlisted USF-native evidence references, retiring those allowlist entries.
forbiddenDrift: Do not reintroduce an external repository as USF lineage or authority.
Do not add an external cross-repository discriminator to a governed semantic or ADR reference.
Do not reintroduce a historical external authority class into the authority order.
Do not upgrade or downgrade any proof level, provider class, or environment while re-attributing evidence.
Do not delete the source-import manifest's self-defined source paths or target concepts.
aiAlignmentRules: Agents must treat USF as self-defined and must not treat any external repository as USF authority or lineage.
Agents must not add a cross-repository discriminator to a governed semantic or ADR reference; lineage narrative belongs in prose, not in governed reference fields.
Agents must preserve proof honesty when re-attributing evidence and never relabel a proof to a stronger level, provider class, or environment.
Agents must not re-found the deferred corpus from this ADR alone; a later authorised phase is required.
rationale: Re-founding USF as self-defined removes an external dependency from the constitutional and mechanism layers while preserving every self-defined artefact the corpus resolves against, so the change is clean rather than lossy. Removing the historical external authority class and re-numbering the authority order keeps the order coherent and closes the ambiguity of an external repository sitting inside the internal precedence chain. Re-attributing rather than deleting the source-import manifest, allowlist, and proof-evidence attribution keeps USF's own source-path registry and hermetic proofs intact and honestly classified, with no proof level or provider class upgraded or downgraded. Discarding the external repository and tag attribution executes the owner's decision that the external lineage record is deliberately discarded, and forbidding cross-repository discriminators in governed references makes the self-defined posture validator-enforced.
description: Records the owner-ratified constitutional amendment that re-founds USF as a self-originating, self-defined foundation with no external repository lineage: it removes the historical external-repository authority class (formerly rank 6) from the Authority Model, re-founds the source-import manifest, source-reference allowlist, and normalised proof-evidence attribution to the self-defined usf model, discards the external repository/tag attribution, and forbids future cross-repository discriminators in governed references.
aiGuidance: Use this ADR when evaluating USF's self-defined posture: USF claims no external repository as authority or lineage, the authority order is six ranks ending in generated reports, and the source-import manifest, allowlist, and proof-evidence attribution are self-defined usf artefacts. A governed semantic or ADR reference must be a canonical repository-local USF reference; a cross-repository discriminator in a governed reference is forbidden. Do not re-found the deferred parity/equivalence corpus, react-app service, ADR 0005, or non-UI parity validator from this ADR alone.
